glossary.definition: A highly compatible plain text file representation system where it organizes data into rows and columns, separated by comma resulting in smaller file size and high readability of complex datasets and is widely supported by standard analytical tools.

A programmatical process of reducing a complex, multi dimensional hierarchical object like JSON into a single layered tabular format by mapping out the network. It is suitable for standard database applications and business reports.
A specific text to character sequence, such as a comma, semicolon, or tab space, which acts as a structural boundary marker between adjacent information fields inside a data grid.

A tracking convention used by the systems to identify a specific path inside nested object clusters by combining the parent field / fields with their childrens by using a simple point character separator.

When computation runs on the client side i.e. on the browser which updates the document object model (DOM) of a website. These are scripts that perform heavy data parsing tasks directly on the visitor machine by using ltheir ocal browser resources, rather than transmitting sensitive payloads over the web to a remote backend server.
